{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Define the group
mask_new_paid_search = (df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')

count_new_paid_search = mask_new_paid_search.sum()
print(f"Total count in group: {count_new_paid_search}")

# Check converted values for refunded orders in this group
refunded_in_group = df.loc[mask_new_paid_search, 'status'] == 'refunded'
converted_for_refunded = df.loc[mask_new_paid_search & refunded_in_group, 'converted']
print(f"Converted values for refunded orders in group: {converted_for_refunded.tolist()}")

# Check for QA orders (revenue == '999999.99') in this group
qa_orders_in_group = df.loc[mask_new_paid_search, 'revenue'] == '999999.99'
print(f"Number of QA orders in group: {qa_orders_in_group.sum()}")

# Check if any QA orders are in the group
if qa_orders_in_group.sum() > 0:
    print(f"QA order IDs in group: {df.loc[mask_new_paid_search & qa_orders_in_group, 'order_id'].tolist()}")

# Final calculation
converted_count = df.loc[mask_new_paid_search, 'converted'].sum()
fraction_converted = converted_count / count_new_paid_search

print(f"Final fraction converted: {fraction_converted}")"}
